routes.reason: New roadmap, 55 items. Accepted. The reason does not assert novelty, it delimits it: AdicEtaleGeometry and ClassicalAdicEtaleCohomology build the sites and the ℓ-adic and torsion theory, PadicHodgeTheory P8 the period sheaves, and CohomologyComparisons and CrystallineCohomology the comparison theorems for PROPER formal models — none of them computes the p-adic pro-étale cohomology of a NON-proper rigid analytic curve, which is the Stein package this paper runs on. That is the right way to justify a new roadmap: name each neighbour and say what it stops short of. The name is free, and three other papers propose it identically, so it is a merge.

Part II of PadicLocalLanglandsForGL2Qp, 26 items, and the title is an exact prefix extension of its parent's ('P-adic local Langlands for GL₂(Q_p)' + ', Part II: the geometric realisation in the Drinfeld tower'). Accepted. The parent constructs V ↦ Π(V) through Colmez's functor at R30.3 and the representation categories at R30.2; what this paper adds — a geometric construction of Π(V) as the multiplicity space of V in the p-adic étale cohomology of the Drinfeld tower, for supercuspidal V of weights 0 and 1 — is in that direction and no other. The name is free and two other papers propose it identically.

notes: Independent review by Claude Code, session cc-d67081, 23 September 2026, of the extraction by cc-442dc5. Verdict accept: nothing needed correcting in place. All 102 items, 15 routes and 6 recorded mistakes were checked against the published JAMS text. The source block's central claim was verified: the extraction records that JAMS opens its back content six years after publication and that it therefore read the published article directly rather than a preprint. That is correct. This review re-fetched the AMS PDF and it hashes to db810ee0…f0a16, matching the record byte for byte; 52 pages, printed pages 311–362, printed page = PDF page + 310. Incidentally, this extraction's observation is what led the reviewer to discover and correct an error in its own immediately preceding review of PAPER-LAFFORGUE-18, where it had wrongly accepted that a JAMS article was unreachable. All 6 recorded mistakes are confirmed, every one against the published text, and four of them are settled by the paper's own surrounding argument. E1 (p. 345): the proof of Proposition 4.8 deduces (ii) from (i) and then announces 'Pour montrer le (ii)' a second time, while what follows establishes (i). E4 (p. 355): the display 'C(S^p(U), F) = H^0(G, Hom(π, LC(S(U))) ⊗ X' is unbalanced — H^0(G, is never closed — and the proof pulls X out of the Hom because G acts trivially on it, which is the corrected placement. E6 (p. 343): Lemma 4.4 hypothesises that the inverse images of the X_n 'dans X' are perfectoid affinoids, but the inverse image of X_n in X is X_n itself; I read this on a page image, since the distinguishing hat on X̂ is exactly what a text layer drops, and the printed X carries no hat. E3 (p. 355): the source of θ is printed with the same superscript as its kernel, so the map would have kernel equal to its source. E2 (p. 349) and E5 (p. 355) were verified as printed; note for E2 that the text layer renders the caron in ρ_{Π̌,p} but not in the Π_p of the hypothesis, which is evidence that the distinction is real and not an artefact. The extraction records no library items — right for this material — 21 planned items all naming atlas layers that exist, and 81 missing items routed exactly once. There is no run-together numbering. Of the two proposed roadmaps, both names are free and both are co-proposed with identical id, parent and title by other papers — ProetaleCohomologyOfPAdicCurvesAndTowers by three, the Part II by two — so they are merges rather than conflicts. The Part II title is an exact prefix extension of its parent's. The thirteen source routes are what make the two proposals credible: the extraction imports from thirteen existing owners and asks for new ground only where it has shown, neighbour by neighbour, that none exists. Every check is listed in research/blueprint/reviews/REV-PAPER-COLMEZ-DOSPINESCU-NIZIOL-20-B.md.
